texts.facts: It is the case of the petitioner that he is carrying on business of Hotel/Restaurant in the name and style "Hotel Farzan Family Restaurant & Parcel Point", for which he had taken the Trade License and the same is renewed from time to time and is valid upto 31.03.2027. The petitioner's shop has been registered under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, NC: 2026:KHC-D:1133 HC-KAR 1961 and also under the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India. 3. It is the grievance of the petitioner that repeatedly during the last week of November, 2025 and first week of December 2025, the officers of respondent No.3 visited the hotel of the petitioner and started abusing them in the presence of customers and also warned the petitioner to close their shop at 10 p.m., otherwise they would register a case and also informed that they have instructions from the higher officers to take up action. He submitted that when the respondents have insisted to close the restaurant, the similarly placed people have filed WP No.106364 of 2024 and connected matters. The said petitions were allowed by order dated 20.11.2024 and directions were issued to the respondent/Authorities not to restrict the business hours of the petitioner therein till 01.00 a.m. as per the Official Memorandum/Notification dated 19.09.2024 issued by the State Government. It is submitted that the respondents are not adhering to the said Notification that is issued by the government and also several orders that are passed by Co- ordinate Benches of this Court from time to time.
texts.arguments: . ii) Grant such other relief as this Hon'ble Court deems fit in the circumstances of the case." 2. NC: 2026:KHC-D:1133 HC-KAR 4. Learned AGA appearing on behalf of the respondents submits that as per his instructions, they are not interfering with the business of the petitioner. However, it is submitted that even as per the order, which the petitioner is relying upon, if any illegal activities are carried out by the petitioner, the respondents are always at liberty to visit the premises and take action in accordance with law. The grievance of the petitioner is that they are interfering with the business of the petitioner and they are insisting him to close the business by 10 p.m. and as per the notification issued by the government, they can keep it open till 01.00 a.m. Learned AGA submits that they are not interfering with the business of the petitioner.
